svg.title: LangGraph recruitment pipeline v3 with CV classifier gate
svg.desc: Final architecture showing email classifier node as a gate before CV ingestion, plus screening, judge, HITL, audit, routing and scheduling nodes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I poll a mailbox for new emails in Python to trigger the LangGraph pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does the CV classifier node detect whether an email contains a CV — what logic and LLM prompt should I use?')
g.text: Detect CV in attachment or body
Flag file type, extract correct attachment

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should happen when no CV is detected — log it, reply to sender, or silently discard?')
sendPrompt('What does the ingest node parse from the CV — what fields go into the structured data output?')
sendPrompt('What Pydantic schema should the screening node return and what fields should it score?')
g.text: Groq LLM scores vs role criteria

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the judge node prompt look like — how does it critique the screener Pydantic output field by field?')
sendPrompt('When screener and judge agree, does it auto-pass directly to routing or still log to audit first?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement LangGraph interrupt and resume for the HITL checkpoint with a simple CLI or web form?')
sendPrompt('What are all the Excel column names for the HR audit sheet based on the screening and judge Pydantic schemas?')
g.text: Append row to Excel — schema as columns

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should the rejection email say and should the HR audit row be updated with sent status?')
sendPrompt('How does the routing node map division and role to the correct department head contact?')
sendPrompt('How do I connect the scheduling node to Google Calendar or Microsoft 365 to book interview slots?')
